svg.title: CH32X035G8U6 minimum-component Android USB host and GPIO circuit
svg.desc: 12 board components. USB ISP via a separate USB-A pogo fixture. Equal net labels are connected. J2 is the phone port.
svg.text: Functional board: 17 components / 13 BOM lines. Equal net labels are connected. Pin numbers are package-specific.
C1 at U1; C2 at U2 IN
ILIMIT fixed: typ. 2.2 A (RT9742C); CC advertises 1.5 A
2 MCU, PHONE USB-C AND THE TWO LOGIC SIGNALS
IN: dry contact via H3 (short pins 1-2 = high); common GND
PA1: high-side P-MOS Q1; OUT = 5 V power at H2.2, active-LOW, default off (R5 1k pull-up).
PC10 / PC11: floating input. Other unused IO: NC.
Fixture (optional backup): PC USB-A +5V->TP1, GND->TP2, D-->TP3, D+->TP4.
Programming: hold SW1, plug J2 into PC USB-A (Type-C PC also needs J1 power), release, then WCHISPTool.
J2 is time-shared: phone port at runtime, PC programming port (hold SW1 at power-up) for ISP.
On-board parts: R6 + SW1 in BOM.
Functional prototype schematic, not a PCB layout. ESD / surge protection is not included in the 17-part baseline.
